title: Reaching Points
summary: Determine if the point (sx, sy) can be transformed into (tx, ty) using the operations (x, y) -> (x, x + y) or (x, y) -> (x + y, y).
statement: Determine if the point (sx, sy) can be transformed into (tx, ty) using the operations (x, y) -> (x, x + y) or (x, y) -> (x + y, y). Return true if possible, otherwise false.
constraints: Start with positive coordinates sx, sy.
Return whether target tx, ty is reachable.
hints: Reverse additions from the larger target coordinate.
Modulo removes as many repeated additions of the smaller coordinate as possible.
When one coordinate reaches its start, check whether the other differs by a nonnegative multiple.
Forward moves strictly increase one coordinate, so the reverse choice is forced until a starting coordinate is reached.
